Model Text Summary:
An autobiographical letter by Dr. Verghese Kurien, the architect of Operation Flood and father of India's White Revolution, addressed to his grandson Siddharth. Kurien shares how his unexpected posting to Anand, Gujarat led to the creation of the Amul cooperative model. By empowering dairy farmers to own their production, processing, and marketing, Kurien eliminated middleman exploitation, transformed India from a milk-importing nation to the world's largest milk producer, and demonstrated that service to rural India gives life true meaning.
